reading.body:
A data center in Dueville, Italy appears in OpenStreetMap under the name Set, with no operator, no capacity figure, and no detail beyond its coordinates.

The record is a single OSM way tagged telecom=data_center, at 45.6424 north and 11.5749 east, in the Veneto region near Vicenza. The name "Set" is short and generic, and could be an abbreviation, an acronym, or a fragment of a longer business name. Nothing in the data identifies a company behind it.

For AI infrastructure the significance is what is absent. The megawatt value is zero, which here reads as unrecorded rather than as a facility drawing no power. A site of unknown size cannot be counted toward regional electricity demand, and the Veneto's mix of light industry and small technology businesses makes a small IT operation plausible without confirming one. The nearest airport, Padova Gino Allegri Airfield at 21.6 miles, fixes the location but adds nothing about the facility.

What this does not tell the reader is whether the site is a colocation hall, a single rack, or a stale map entry. The only source is an OpenStreetMap tagging review dated 2026-09-04, and the research status is exhausted, so the missing operator is missing evidence rather than evidence of no operator.
